description: This file defines the UserInterfaceSettingsFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for managing the user interface settings screen in the AnySoftKeyboard app. It handles view creation, navigation to other settings screens, and initializes a demo keyboard view.

classes.name: UserInterfaceSettingsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages the user interface settings screen, including initializing views, handling button clicks, and navigating to other settings fragments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the user interface settings fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes view components, sets click listeners, and adjusts UI based on device orientation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title and initializes a demo keyboard for display.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on settings tiles and navigates to corresponding settings screens.
